Components

Each page shows a component in every variant and state, with a do and a don't.

  • Alert A message inside a view about the state of what the view shows. draft
  • App header The top bar of an app: the product name or the current view's title, with an optional back link, actions and a tray for approvals that are waiting. draft
  • Approval One request from an agent that waits for the reader's answer: what would run, where, for whom and why, with Allow and Decline. draft
  • Badge A status in a word or two, such as a task's station. draft
  • Banner One message about the state of the whole app, across the full width under the app header. draft
  • Button An action the reader takes on the current view. draft
  • Code block A block of mono text for a command, a log or a program's output. draft
  • Composer The prompt input under a transcript: a textarea that grows with its content, and Send. draft
  • Copy field A read-only value the reader takes somewhere else, with a button that copies it. draft
  • Diff One file's change as a unified diff, with its path and how many lines were added and removed. draft
  • Disclosure A native details element that shows or hides detail under a summary written in text. draft
  • Empty state What a view shows when it has no data yet, with the way to get some. draft
  • Error state What a view shows when its data could not be loaded, with a way to try again. draft
  • Field One labelled control, a text input, a textarea or a select, with its description and its error message. draft
  • Link A text link to another view or another site: in running text, standing alone, external or quiet. draft
  • List Rows one above the other, each with a primary line and room for a second line, an icon, and trailing text or one quiet action. draft
  • Message One row of an agent transcript: a prompt, the agent's text, a tool call, its result, a denial, usage or the end of a turn. draft
  • Page header The top of a view: its title, an optional one-line description and the view's one optional primary action. draft
  • Pending tray How many approvals are waiting for the reader, in words and a count, linking to the queue from every screen. draft
  • Select A native select as the control of a field, for one choice from a short fixed list. draft
  • Spinner A sign that something is in progress when how long it will take is not known. draft
  • Streaming The note that the agent is still producing output: a small turning mark and words that say what is happening. draft
  • Tab bar The two to five main destinations of an app, along the bottom of a phone screen, each with an icon and a text label. draft
  • Textarea The multi-line control of a field, which grows with what the reader types. draft
